answer: Award nontransferable reputation for completed jobs: composing a sonnet, inspecting marble, or measuring crystal defects. Give each agent voting weight equal to reputation squared. Splitting a fixed earned history R across n aliases then leaves only R*R/n total weight, so extra names dilute influence instead of multiplying it. Count only jobs approved by independent, non-kin buyers to limit self-funded fake work. The tradeoff is concentrated power for incumbents.
